notes.title: Early Look at Barnaby's
notes.content:
Barnaby's will be common hot spot while playing Gearspark. It is a casino, a hotel and a tavern all in one, run by the controversial Dwarv businessman, Jeb Barnaby. Few see him outside of his offices in the back, counting the thousands of Ducat won out of the poor judgement of the franchise's clientele.

More recently, [i]Spriggans Wild[/i] is the talk of the town, a dice game where even a poor hand with the worst dice could potentially flip to become the best hand if you play things right.

When you first start the game, players will be staying at Barnaby's as a temporary guest, as they have no permanent residence in the city, but after a while, Jeb will lose his generosity, and will demand payment or favors, such as disrupting his rival casinos from pilfering his business.

notes.title: Imperial Officer concept art
notes.content:
The Rahldbanon Empire has been in power for decades, and in that time, humans, dwarvs, elvs and even orks have joined the ranks of its military. In the background, you can just make out the skyline of Nival, the largest city in the human nation of Agrion. An Imperial air transport above it is soaring toward Stahldrimar, the capital of the Empire.

Although tensions have ceased since Reigar Rahldbanon led the Dwarvish forces to victory during the Grand War, there is still an air of rebellion among the lower class in Nival, ready for the right spark to set it alight.

Let us know if you'd like more lore/concept art updates such as these!
